AVast karst peak forest at dawn, steep limestone towers rising from forested valleys, layers of cyan blue mist between peaks, wet vegetation on stone, a tiny human figure on a narrow ridge for scale. Cinematic live action realism, photorealistic creature design, practical VFX realism, immense scale, atmospheric depth, sharp focus, low ISO.
